# Browser dependencies

Bundled to avoid CDN-dependent startup.

- Leaflet 1.9.4: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/ (BSD-2-Clause)
- Leaflet Draw 1.0.4: https://unpkg.com/leaflet-draw@1.0.4/ (MIT)
- Chart.js 4.4.2: https://unpkg.com/chart.js@4.4.2/ (MIT)
- gifshot 0.3.2: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gifshot/0.3.2/gifshot.min.js (MIT)
- Leaflet side-by-side 2.0.0: see adjacent license.
